Fantastic first night.
Feb 2026 • Couples
EM was our host for this evening. Very well presented, extremely well mannered and brought a tranquility to the setting for me and my partner after a day of traveling. We shared some main dishes - Chicken Tikka from the grill and traditional cook in sauce. The chef came out to meet us which we found very special - stating “this is your home” - such a delight. 
We choose a mild in heat and was very pleasant to eat, I would chose slightly hotter on a daring day as the taste is phenomenal. They offered some mosquito spray which provides comfort in knowledge whilst eating outside in a lovely setting. Cost and quality is perfect and we will be eating here again. Like a little Indian paradise in Phu Quoc. Thank you to all the staff involved.
